summary: This filing is a Form 6-K submitting proxy materials and audited financial statements for Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A.'s 2026 annual general meeting (AGM), scheduled for June 4, 2026. The agenda includes approval of consolidated financial statements and other routine items. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, management change, or strategic review—is described. The document is a standard AGM notice and proxy circular for a foreign private issuer, akin to a U.S. proxy statement. As there is no transactional or activist component, this is classified as routine corporate governance and not a special situation.
